title: On Bleeding for most of the night
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：bleed　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bleed 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the clerk ① bled for most of the night year after year, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② bleeds for most of the night for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ bleed for most of the night at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ bled for most of the night before — a line in the file for May 1970 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Bleeding for most of the night year after year, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ bleed slowly into the sand for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Bleed slowly into the sand at once and never mention it again.

By 1983 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ bleeds slowly into the sand year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ bled for most of the night again when nobody else would.

⑩ To bleed for most of the night, my mother said in 1988, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody bleeds for most of the night for the whole place again and somebody must bleed for most of the night year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 流血（一般过去式 bled for most of the night：1976 年书记员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 流血（一般现在 bleeds for most of the night：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 流血（不定式 to bleed for most of the night：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 流血（过去完成时 had bled for most of the night：1970 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 流血（动名词 bleeding for most of the night 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 渗出（bleed slowly into the sand：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去渗出慢慢地渗进沙里）
G. v. 渗出（bleed slowly into the sand：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 流血（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 bleeds slowly into the sand，而母亲又一次 bled for most of the night）

answers.why: bleed 意为“流血”，1976 年书记员年年地流血大半宿都在流血，那是办事处里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 bled。
bleed 意为“流血”，自那以后书记员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 bleeds。
bleed 意为“流血”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯流血大半宿都在流血”，此处为不定式 to bleed for most of the night。
bleed 意为“流血”，卷宗里 五月 那行字说明早在 1983 年之前就有人流血过，故用过去完成时 had bled。
bleed 意为“流血”，书记员说“流血大半宿都在流血这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 bleeding for most of the night 作主语。
bleed 意为“渗出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去渗出慢慢地渗进沙里”，should ever 之后用原形 bleed slowly into the sand。
bleed 意为“渗出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻渗出慢慢地渗进沙里（bleed slowly into the sand at once），以后再也不要提起。
bleed 意为“流血”，新来的申请人每个月份都照例渗出慢慢地渗进沙里，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 bleeds。
bleed 意为“流血”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地流血大半宿都在流血，用一般过去式 bled 叙述。
bleed 意为“流血”，结尾那句是母亲 1988 年的话：要流血大半宿都在流血，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 bleed 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the clerk bled for most of the night year after year, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk bleeds for most of the night for the whole place whenever the office asks.
Bleeding for most of the night year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever bleed slowly into the sand for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office bleeds slowly into the sand year after year every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother bled for most of the night again, and the office remembered that half.
